g.text: The admin handler does NOT touch ConfigProvider —
the routing table is unchanged by this call.
Routing level: out-of-band update (NOT done by rr-admin)
the app must update every node itself.
watch event (EtcdConfigProvider observes; Rr never writes back)
(as learner — catches up via AppendEntries / snapshot)
(may trigger snapshot transfer if log-gap too large)
Raft level: promote to voter (manual path; auto-promote disabled)
(new config must be committed by both old and new quorums)
Nothing writes back to the ConfigProvider after the change.
Clients learn the current leader via leader_info redirects.
